question_en:
I am completing an old handover record for early production asset reviews. The four-digit numbers in the image are all asset IDs: first, find the original release record corresponding to the starting ID at the top; then, based on the uploader in that record, locate the column with the same name in the image, read the next asset ID given in that column, and continue; stop after entering the uploader column labeled "General Archive". Please answer the following questions:

1. Which original asset record corresponds to the starting work order? Please provide the asset ID, official title, uploader, job title, and upload date. Starting from the initial work order, sequentially read the current record's uploader name and the next asset ID in the column with the same name until entering "General Archive". What is the complete handover sequence? Please list the ID, official title, uploader, job title, and upload date for each asset.
2. What is the frame size of the asset that enters "General Archive"? What is its reuse license?

Answer Format: Please answer in points numbered (1)–(2); for Question 1, use a table to list the complete sequence from the starting work order to "General Archive" along with the requested fields, listing the starting record only once; for Question 2, provide the size and reuse license in text.
